description.short_caption: Multiple skin lesions on the dorsal hand.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the dorsal aspect of a hand with multiple skin lesions. The lesions vary in size and appearance, including erythematous macules, papules, and some with central necrosis or crusting. The surrounding skin appears mildly erythematous, and there is no visible discharge. The lesions are scattered and appear to be at different stages of development.
visible_findings: central necrosis or crusting in some lesions

description.short_caption: Multiple skin lesions on the dorsum of the hand.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the dorsum of a hand with multiple erythematous papules and pustules, some with central umbilication or crusting. The lesions are scattered and vary slightly in size. The surrounding skin appears unremarkable. The presence of a ring on the finger suggests this is an adult hand.

description.short_caption: Multiple erythematous skin lesions with central clearing on the arm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows multiple erythematous, circular lesions distributed on the skin of the arm. The lesions have a raised, red border and central clearing, giving them a target-like or annular appearance. The surrounding skin appears unremarkable. The image is well-focused and provides a clear view of the lesions' morphology.
